ApiVersion.description: The catalog API version that produced the document; any version of this major.

AsRegisteredBy.description: ``current(as_registered_by(package id))``: the transform that package used per set.

CatalogFinding.description: A structured refusal or warning. Calls report evidence and request problems this way.

ClockMerge.description: A caller-named reference clock and the ``ClockMapping`` record ids to merge with (§3).

ContentId.description: A tier-1 id: sha256 of complete bytes.

DeclaredKey.description: A declared identifier: a ``LogicalId`` or a software content identifier (ADR 0003 §1).

EvidenceAnchor.description: A source content id plus a locator: a record-level ``EvidenceRef`` (ADR 0003 §1).

History.description: ``history()``: every entry, nothing collapsed or hidden (ADR 0003 §4.2).

KindCount.description: How many records of one kind a registered package holds.

KnowledgeOfInteger.description: A Knowledge state of the Ledger's own (no provenance; never known_absent).

KnowledgeOfPackageId.description: A Knowledge state of the Ledger's own (no provenance; never known_absent).

KnowledgeOfRecordKind.description: A Knowledge state of the Ledger's own (no provenance; never known_absent).

KnowledgeOfString.description: A Knowledge state of the Ledger's own (no provenance; never known_absent).

KnowledgeOfTierTwoId.description: A Knowledge state of the Ledger's own (no provenance; never known_absent).

KnowledgeOfTransactionKey.description: A Knowledge state of the Ledger's own (no provenance; never known_absent).

KnowledgeOfTransformInfo.description: A Knowledge state of the Ledger's own (no provenance; never known_absent).

KnowledgeOfWorldTime.description: A Knowledge state of the Ledger's own (no provenance; never known_absent).

LatestTransform.description: ``current(latest_transform)``: the undominated transform per lineage set (ADR 0003 §4.4).

LineageGraph.description: The lineage behind one record id (root ADR 0016; Ledger ADR 0003 §4.1).

LineageNode.description: A transform in the DAG; ``transform`` is ``NotCovered`` when an edge names a transform that no registered package holds (the edge is kept, ADR 0002 §5).

LineageRequest.description: ``lineage(record_id)``: the transform DAG behind one record and its lineage siblings.

LineageSet.description: ``(thread, record kind, source content id)`` and how this view resolved it (§4.1, §4.3).

LocatorStep.description: One locator step exactly as the package states it (package-schema EvidenceRef).

MappedInterval.description: An entry's interval on the reference clock and the mapping ids of its path (§3.4-3.5).

MappingPath.description: One path of ``ClockMapping`` record ids, from an entry's clock to the reference clock.

Membership.description: One thread a record is a member of, in one registering package, with its roles.

PackageId.description: A package's id: the sha256 of its manifest.json.

Partition.description: A run of entries whose adjacency means something (ADR 0003 §3).

Pinned.description: ``current(pinned(transform id))``: that transform where it appears; ``NotCovered`` else.

QueryCursor.description: A ``query`` row's sort key; ``QuerySpec.after`` returns the rows strictly after it.

QueryMeta.description: What a ``query`` result's Arrow schema metadata carries besides its rows.

QueryRow.description: One row of a ``query`` result; the Arrow columns are these fields, in this order.

QuerySpec.description: The filter contract ``query`` implements (MVL-98): kinds, a window, a thread, packages.

RecordId.description: A record's key in its table: a tier-2 id, or a content id for source_artifact.

RecordKind.description: A record kind, by the package-schema contract (contracts/package-schema): the kind of a record table at the schema version its package declares. Not enumerated here, so a package-schema version that adds kinds changes no catalog-api version.

RecordRef.description: One catalogued record in one package: ``line`` is its 1-based line in its table.

Region.description: The innermost locator step, which says what part of the source is cited.

RegisterRequest.description: ``register(package_root)``: catalogue the package at a local directory.

Resolution.description: What the catalog knows about one evidence anchor.

ResolveRequest.description: ``resolve(evidence_ref)``: where cited evidence lives and how to fetch it.

RevisionEdge.description: ``(thread, kind, source) revises (thread, kind, revises)`` through two source revisions.

SourceLocation.description: One package's route to the source bytes (ADR 0002 ``package_source``, ``source_location``).

StatedKnowledgeOfTimePoint.description: A package field's Knowledge state restated verbatim, provenance included.

Thread.description: One thread at one catalog point, in the requested order and view (ADR 0003 §3-§5).

ThreadEntry.description: One entry: a record id, its roles, and every package that registered it in this view.

ThreadKey.description: ``ThreadKey(kind, key)`` (ADR 0003 §1). Its JSON form is what ``thread_id`` hashes.

ThreadLink.description: An ``IdentityLink`` record relating two declared threads; never a merge (§1.5).

ThreadsOf.description: Every thread of one record id, sorted by thread id then package id. Co-declared keys give several memberships; the Ledger reports them and never unions the threads.

ThreadsOfRequest.description: ``threads_of(record_id)``: every thread a record belongs to (ADR 0003 §1.4).

Ticks.description: Integer ticks on one clock, exactly as the package states them; never converted.

TierTwoId.description: A tier-2 id: a transform, a timestamp domain (clock key) or a clock mapping.

TimePoint.description: A timestamp as a package states it: ticks on one clock (root ADR 0005). Never converted.

TimeWindow.description: ``[first, last]`` ticks, both inclusive, on one clock. Never applied across clocks.

TransactionKey.description: A point in the catalog's transaction order (ADR 0002 §4): one registration's tick.

UnresolvedMember.description: A record whose ``Ambiguous`` field names this thread among its candidates (§2).

UnresolvedMembership.description: A thread a record's ``Ambiguous`` field (at ``pointer``) names as a candidate.

VerifyReport.description: Whether a registered package's bytes still match its id and its manifest.

VerifyRequest.description: ``verify(package_id)``: re-hash a registered package where it was registered from.

WorldTime.description: An entry's world time (ADR 0003 §3): its start ``s`` and its end ``e`` as stated.

description: Requests and responses of the Neptune Ledger catalog API (packages/neptune-ledger/docs/catalog-api.md). Validate a document against #/$defs/<RecordName>.
